subject.title: fix(control-ui): resolve Personal card avatar 401 via data URI

question: Should maintainers repair this narrow branch as the landing path for the Personal-card avatar fix, or consolidate on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 after its remaining blocker is resolved?
rationale: Automation can identify the mechanical blockers, but choosing between a conflicted narrow PR and the broader proof-positive overlapping PR is a maintainer routing decision for the linked issue cluster.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader proof-positive PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 as the canonical landing candidate after its SDK/export blocker is repaired, then close or supersede this PR with the paired issue preserved until merge.

options.title: Repair this narrow PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or an opted-in repair lane to port the fix to current main, fix the type/lint blockers, add focused tests, and attach observable browser/network proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Leave this PR open for the author to resolve the conflict, validation failures, and proof gap without choosing a canonical replacement yet.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the broader proof-positive PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 as the canonical landing candidate after its SDK/export blocker is repaired, then close or supersede this PR with the paired issue preserved until merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current avatar/UI projection lines are carried by this owner’s recent baseline work, and this choice spans Gateway avatar behavior plus Control UI rendering.
